report:
Thyroid, right lobe nodule, ultrasound-guided fine needle aspiration

Received are two air-dried and two alcohol-fixed smears and a needle rinse (blood-stained), processed as cytospin (1 slide) and cell block (1 block).

The smears (4 slides), cytospin (1 slide) and cell block (1 slide) are adequate for evaluation and show abundant colloid, follicular cells in flat, evenly spaced sheets and haemosiderin-laden macrophages. Features are those of a benign follicular nodule.

THYROID, right lobe nodule, ultrasound-guided fine needle aspiration - BENIGN FOLLICULAR NODULE (Bethesda II: Benign)
